sources.notes: 2026-10-07 review verified: The v3 report endpoint supports up to three breakdowns and documents DATE, CAMPAIGN_ID, and AD_ID in the official reporting schema and metric reference. sources.notes: 2026-10-12 verification: Developer tokens were sunset on September 9, 2026. API v25 throws CLOUD_PROJECT_NOT_APPROVED_FOR_PRODUCTION when a project with Test access calls a production account; older versions return ACTION_NOT_PERMITTED.

The v23 entry (2026-01-28) records that support for call ads was removed. Only part of the long page was read.

sources.title: Video Action Campaigns are being upgraded to Demand Gen
sources.notes: 2026-10-12 verification: Google removed creation of new Video Action Campaigns in April 2025, began automatic upgrades in July 2025, and states final campaigns are automatically upgraded to Demand Gen by April 2026 (the page does not mention May 2026). Original campaigns remain in the account as removed or paused and keep historical data viewable through status filters; spend in the original is not counted by the new Demand Gen campaign. The page carries conflicting timing text in places and no update date.

sources.title: Dynamic Search Ads upgrade to AI Max timeline
sources.notes: 2026-10-12 verification: Post dated 2026-04-15 originally said legacy features such as Dynamic Search Ads would start upgrading to AI Max in September. An update dated 2026-06-11 extends the Dynamic Search Ads sunset and automatic upgrade, which will begin in February 2027, and says automatic upgrades for Automatically Created Assets and campaign-level broad match continue starting September 2026. Help-center pages were not re-read for timing and may still show the earlier date.

sources.title: Minimum Budget Requirement for Demand Gen Campaigns
sources.license: Google Developers content CC BY 4.0 and samples Apache-2.0 unless noted
sources.notes: 2026-10-12 verification: Google Ads Developer Blog post dated 2026-02-27. From April 1, 2026 the Google Ads API enforces a minimum daily budget of 5 USD (or the local-currency equivalent) for all Demand Gen campaigns. API v21 and above return BUDGET_BELOW_DAILY_MINIMUM when creating or updating a campaign below the floor. Existing Demand Gen campaigns already below the floor continue serving without interruption. This is an API enforcement note and is not a recommended budget.

sources.title: How to transition from call ads to call assets
sources.notes: 2026-10-12 verification: Key dates on the page: February 2026, all options to create a new call-only ad are removed; February 2027, all existing call-only ads stop receiving impressions. Google steers advertisers to responsive search ads with call assets.

sources.title: Commission FAQ on transparency obligations under Article 50 of the AI Act
sources.license: European Commission reuse policy; citation only
sources.notes: 2026-10-12 verification: FAQ updated 24 July 2026 states Article 50 applies from 2 August 2026 and that a limited grace period is envisaged only for AI systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026, whose providers must comply with the Article 50(2) marking and detection obligation only from 2 December 2026. The FAQ names no amending regulation. The amending instrument is Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, verified on EUR-Lex (see eu-digital-omnibus-ai-regulation-2026-1744-official).

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 (Digital Omnibus on AI), Official Journal
sources.license: European Commission reuse policy; citation only
sources.notes: 2026-10-12 verification on EUR-Lex: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 8 July 2026 amending Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, published in the Official Journal on 24.7.2026 and shown as in force. Recital 38 and an added paragraph 4 state that providers of AI systems generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content that were placed on the market before 2 August 2026 shall take the necessary steps to comply with Article 50(2) by 2 December 2026.
